title: Varied Logs
description: Varied Logs enriches Minecraft with diverse, dynamic textures for all vanilla logs, making forests and builds feel more natural and unique.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba5eca3d5b0b6a3f319f8379e834eabf33ebb133_0.webp)

Varied Logs enhances Minecraft’s vanilla wood logs with multiple texture variations and subtle animated details, making forests, builds, and landscapes feel more natural and alive.

Instead of repetitive identical logs, each block can appear with a unique texture variation, adding visual diversity while keeping the original Minecraft style intact.

Features
- Multiple texture variations for vanilla logs
- Seamless integration with the default Minecraft aesthetic
- Subtle animated textures
- Better-looking forests and wooden builds
- Lightweight and performance-friendly

Perfect for players who want more visual variety without changing the core feel of Minecraft.
